folleto.interna: Internal tool: it doesn’t appear on the public site.
folleto.texto: A 252 × 176 mm sheet that folds into 8 card-sized panels and goes inside the box, with the packaging.
folleto.personalizado: With the deck saved in this browser: title, dedication, players and lives for its number of cards, and only the icons it uses.
folleto.generico: Generic version: the one that goes in the standard box.
folleto.sinMazo: There’s no deck saved in this browser, so this is the generic version.
folleto.verPersonalizado: See the version with this browser’s deck
folleto.pdf: For the printer’s PDF, with the portal running and HERRAMIENTAS_INTERNAS=1: pnpm instrucciones:pdf. It’s saved in salidas/folleto/.
folleto.plegadoTexto: Fold in half lengthwise (side A outside), then accordion-fold along the three vertical lines. The cover panel ends up on top.
folleto.impresion: Print on landscape A4, double-sided flipping on the short edge, at 100%. Cut along the corner marks; the side marks show the folds.

muestrario.texto: Every face of the template with sample data, in each palette, to check them before printing. It’s an internal tool: it doesn’t appear on the public site.

notas.textoLargo: 90 characters, the maximum, and a star memory.
notas.cajaPersonalizada: Paid extra: printed with the order, with the chosen photo.
notas.cajaGenerica: Stock packaging: not in the print file. Always in the default palette.

ejemplos.dedicatoria: For Ana and Leo, who keep adding memories. With love, the family.
ejemplos.textoLargo: The night the whole street lost power and we ended up having dinner by candlelight outside
